Getting Started

Decades GO is the contracting and facilities management platform for Decades Construction & Facilities Group. It manages the full lifecycle of customer relationships, contracts, onboarding, locations, and compliance.

What you can do:

  • Create and manage customers, MSAs, and contracts
  • Generate contract documents (Work Orders, Amendments, Proposals)
  • Track onboarding cases with step-by-step checklists
  • Manage property locations with compliance and appliance tracking
  • Review and approve contracts through the Send Queue
  • Monitor operations, work orders, and sensor alerts

Logging In

Navigate to your portal URL and authenticate with Windows Hello (company standard). After login, the Dashboard loads automatically.

Bookmark your portal URL for quick access. Your session persists across tabs.

New Contract Wizard

Create Work Orders, Amendments, or Vendor MSAs in a guided 5-step wizard. Drafts save automatically so you can resume later.

Contract Wizard — WIP Drafts landing with Resume/Delete actions
Step 1 — Pick the Customer
Search by name. Customer family (Decades vs TPA) auto-detects and determines which templates are used.
Step 2 — Document Type
Choose Work Order, Amendment, or Vendor MSA. Select location, vendor, and set dates. Amendments require a parent Work Order.
Step 3 — Contractor & Signer
Vendor details auto-fill. Enter signer name/title and owner contact information.
Step 4 — Exhibit A Lines
Add line items with cost code, description, and amount. Totals calculate automatically.
Step 5 — Review & Generate
Review all details, see the compliance checklist, and click Generate. The system resolves the correct template, creates a document request, and the flow generates the document.
Drafts are saved at each step. Come back anytime — your progress is preserved.
The compliance checklist appears at Step 5 for customers with compliance rules. It shows which checks pass or fail but does not block generation.

New Proposal Wizard

Create MSA proposals for new customers in a 4-step wizard. Choose a service package (A/B/C), set pricing, add locations, and generate the full proposal package.

Proposal Wizard — WIP Drafts for in-progress proposals
Step 1 — Service Package
Package A (Essential), Package B (Extended), or Package C (Premium). Determines which Exhibit A template is used.
Step 2 — Customer & Vendor
Search for existing customer or create new. Enter MSA details, signer info, and billing address.
Step 3 — Pricing & Locations
Set monthly membership rate and onboarding fee. Choose uniform or type-based pricing. Add locations.
Step 4 — Review & Generate
Review everything, then Generate Proposal. Creates the MSA record, rates, and triggers document generation.
